properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] npm-install spawned process performing cred-file fan-out plus IMDS reach
properties.description:
Detects the post-execution credential-harvest stage of an npm supply-chain compromise: a process spawned under an npm/node/yarn/pnpm or node-gyp (python) parent that, within 10 minutes on the same host, reads two or more distinct cloud/dev credential file paths (.aws/credentials, .ssh/id_rsa, .npmrc, .docker/config.json, ~/.config/gcloud, .kube/config, .azure/accessTokens.json) or contacts cloud instance metadata (169.254.169.254 / metadata.google.internal / metadata.azure.com). This fortnight the @redhat-cloud-services 'Miasma' campaign (Snyk 2026-06-01, StepSecurity 2026-06-02, Microsoft 2026-06-03, Unit 42 2026-06-02) and the self-propagating binding.gyp worm (Snyk + StepSecurity 2026-06-04, Aikido 2026-06-09) drop the same multi-cloud secret harvester targeting AWS/GCP/Azure/GitHub Actions/npm/Vault/SSH/wallet secrets; the npm v12 install-scripts disablement announcement (The Hacker News + Aikido 2026-06-11) and a fresh Web3/cloud wave (Cyber Security News 2026-06-12) confirm the harvest behaviour persists across hook variants (preinstall, postinstall, binding.gyp), making the fan-out the durable signal rather than any single lifecycle hook or IOC. Spans install → credential_access in the kill chain. Fires on developer workstations and CI/CD runners exhibiting the spawn-plus-fan-out pair; does NOT fire on plain `npm install` compiling native modules without touching cred paths, nor on a single legitimate aws-sdk IMDS lookup from a known package's runtime.

Rationale: Across all 10 articles the post-spawn behavior — a single npm/node/gyp-spawned process touching multiple cloud/dev credential paths and/or IMDS — is the invariant; the entry vector rotates between preinstall hooks (Miasma), postinstall hooks (npm v12 announcement), and binding.gyp (worm) but the harvest fan-out persists. Requiring ≥2 distinct cred paths within 10 minutes of an npm-rooted spawn eliminates the single-cred SDK use-case while catching every campaign variant the fortnight surfaced.
properties.query:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let CorrelationMin = 10m;
let InstallSpawn = imProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ParentProcessName matches regex @"(?i)(?:^|[\\/])(npm|node|yarn|pnpm|python|python3|npm-cli\.js)(\.exe)?$"
    | where Process matches regex @"(?i)(?:^|[\\/])(node|python|python3|powershell|pwsh|cmd|sh|bash)(\.exe)?$"
    | where ParentProcessCommandLine has_any ("install"," ci","rebuild","npx") or CommandLine has_any ("binding.gyp","node-gyp","preinstall","postinstall","index.js","node_modules")
    | project InstallTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, Process, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine;
let CredFanOut = imFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType in ("FileAccessed","FileRead","FileOpened","FileCreated","FileModified")
    | where ActingProcessName matches regex @"(?i)(?:^|[\\/])(node|python|python3|powershell|pwsh|sh|bash|curl|wget)(\.exe)?$"
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\.aws\credentials",@"/.aws/credentials",@"\.ssh\id_",@"/.ssh/id_",@"\.npmrc",@"/.npmrc",@"\.docker\config.json",@"/.docker/config.json",@"/.config/gcloud",@"/.kube/config",@"/.azure/accessTokens.json")
       or TargetFileName in~ (".env",".envrc","github_token","credentials","id_rsa","id_ed25519","accessTokens.json")
    | summarize FirstHarvest = min(TimeGenerated), CredPathsTouched = dcount(TargetFilePath), CredFiles = make_set(TargetFilePath, 12) by DvcHostname, ActorUsername
    | where CredPathsTouched >= 2;
InstallSpawn
| join kind=inner CredFanOut on DvcHostname
| where FirstHarvest between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + CorrelationMin)
| project InstallTime, FirstHarvest, DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FirstHarvest, InstallTime), DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, Process, CommandLine, ParentProcessCommandLine, CredPathsTouched, CredFiles
| order by InstallTime desc
